subtitle: 指向Eisenhorn

paragraphs.en: Following Games Workshop’s announcement that horror specialist Mike Flanagan is working on Amazon’s adaptation of Warhammer 40,000 , and that the Haunting of Hill House creator would soon be working on a script, we have further news that this project is a TV series — not a movie — and that Flanagan may have an even more significant role than previously thought.
paragraphs.cn: Games Workshop宣布，恐怖题材专家迈克·弗拉纳根正参与亚马逊改编《战锤40,000》的项目；这位《鬼入侵》主创不久后将着手撰写剧本。如今又有消息称，该项目将是电视剧而非电影，而且弗拉纳根的角色可能比此前认为的更重要。

paragraphs.en: Deadline reports that Flanagan is in talks to join the series as an executive producer, showrunner, writer, and director for the series. So, he’s not just writing the Warhammer 40,000 TV show, he’s creating it.
paragraphs.cn: Deadline报道，弗拉纳根正洽谈以执行制片人、剧集主创、编剧和导演身份加入该剧。因此，他不只是为这部《战锤40,000》电视剧写剧本，更是在打造它。

paragraphs.en: Where does this leave former Superman actor and Warhammer 40,000 superfan Henry Cavill? Games Workshop CEO Kevin Rountree said that Vertigo and Cavill “remain involved as they have been for some time.”
paragraphs.cn: 那么，曾饰演超人的演员、《战锤40,000》超级粉丝亨利·卡维尔又会如何？Games Workshop首席执行官Kevin Rountree表示，Vertigo与卡维尔「和过去一段时间一样，仍在参与其中」。

paragraphs.en: All the way back in December 2022 (yes, it’s been nearly four years since Games Workshop and Amazon announced their intention to work together), Cavill was said to be “bringing his lore expertise to the mantle of Executive Producer, and his sword arm to the starring role.”
paragraphs.cn: 早在2022年12月（没错，Games Workshop与亚马逊宣布有意合作至今已近四年），据称卡维尔将「以自己对设定的专业知识担任执行制片人，并以挥剑本领担纲主演」。

paragraphs.en: “I have loved Warhammer since I was a boy, making this moment truly special for me. The opportunity to shepherd this cinematic universe from its inception is quite the honour and the responsibility,” Cavill said at the time. “I couldn't be more grateful for all the hard work put in by Vertigo, Amazon and Games Workshop to make this happen. One step closer to making a nigh-on lifelong dream come true.”
paragraphs.cn: 卡维尔当时说：「我从小就喜爱《战锤》，这让此刻对我格外特别。从其诞生之初就有机会引领这个电影宇宙，既是一种莫大荣幸，也是一份重大责任。我无比感激Vertigo、亚马逊和Games Workshop为促成此事投入的所有辛勤工作。离实现一个近乎终生的梦想又近了一步。」

paragraphs.en: So, Cavill is still very much involved, and, as far as we can tell, will be in the leading role. But what does Flanagan’s previous work tell us about what to expect?
paragraphs.cn: 因此，卡维尔仍深度参与其中，而且据我们所知会担任主演。但弗拉纳根此前的作品，又能让我们对本剧期待什么？

paragraphs.en: Flanagan is writer, director and showrunner of a number of much-loved Netflix horror TV shows, including The Haunting of Hill House, The Haunting of Bly Manor, The Fall of the House of Usher, Midnight Mass, and The Midnight Club. Earlier this year he signed a multiyear deal with Amazon MGM Studios to develop and produce original series for the studio, and the first of these is an adaptation of Stephen King’s horror classic, Carrie. Presumably, Warhammer 40,000 is the second.
paragraphs.cn: 弗拉纳根担任过多部广受喜爱的Netflix恐怖剧的编剧、导演和剧集主创，包括《鬼入侵》《鬼庄园》《厄舍府的崩塌》《午夜弥撒》及《午夜俱乐部》。今年早些时候，他与Amazon MGM Studios签下多年合约，为该工作室开发并制作原创剧集；其中第一部是改编自斯蒂芬·金恐怖经典《魔女嘉莉》的作品。推想起来，《战锤40,000》便是第二部。

paragraphs.en: That’s a lot of horror, so should we expect a horror-heavy Warhammer 40,000 adaptation? Not necessarily. While there is much about the grimdark far future that is horrific, I do not expect a traditional horror series set in the world of Warhammer 40,000. While there are straight up horror stories in the setting, it is not known for traditional horror.
paragraphs.cn: 恐怖作品可真不少，那么我们是否该期待一部恐怖色彩浓厚的《战锤40,000》改编剧？未必。这个阴郁黑暗的遥远未来有许多恐怖之处，但我并不认为会有一部以《战锤40,000》世界为背景的传统恐怖剧。该设定中确实有纯粹的恐怖故事，但它并不以传统恐怖见长。

paragraphs.en: I also think this Warhammer 40,000 TV show will have to be mindful of staying grounded to a degree, not least to keep it within scope and budget. The Warhammer 40,000 setting is so vast and varied that you have everything from stories about downtrodden humans who scratch about in the lower levels of a Hive world, right up to galaxy-cracking space battles between fleets of voidcraft. Truly, you can do anything in the world of Warhammer 40,000. You can even have metaphorical battles of the mind in space hell.
paragraphs.cn: 我还认为，这部《战锤40,000》电视剧必须在一定程度上保持落地，以便控制规模和预算。《战锤40,000》的设定如此庞大多样：既可以讲在巢都世界下层艰难求生的底层人类，也可以讲虚空舰队之间足以撕裂银河的太空大战。说真的，在《战锤40,000》的世界里什么都能拍，甚至能拍太空地狱中的隐喻性意识之战。

paragraphs.en: So what will the show be about? I keep coming back to Eisenhorn. Let me explain. Last year, I reported on interesting comments from celebrated Black Library author Dan Abnett , who is perhaps the most high-profile Warhammer 40,000 writer today and at the heart of the setting’s development. His long list of Warhammer 40,000 books established much of the lore fans know and love, including the wonderful Gaunt's Ghosts and Eisenhorn series, and key entries in the sprawling The Horus Heresy saga.
paragraphs.cn: 那么这部剧会讲什么？我始终会想到Eisenhorn。让我解释一下。去年，我报道过知名Black Library作者Dan Abnett的一些耐人寻味的评论；他或许是当今最具知名度的《战锤40,000》作家，也是该设定发展的核心人物。他长期创作的《战锤40,000》小说奠定了粉丝喜爱的许多设定，包括精彩的《Gaunt's Ghosts》和Eisenhorn系列，以及宏大的《荷鲁斯叛乱》系列中的关键作品。

paragraphs.en: Eisenhorn is a trilogy of sci-fi crime novels that revolve around inquisitors Gregor Eisenhorn and Gideon Ravenor (Ravenor got his own spinoff series). The gist is they hunt heretics and daemons while fending off the brain-melting powers of Chaos. While the story is set within the Warhammer 40,000 universe, it is more focused and smaller in scope than some of the other, galaxy-spanning 40K stories that involve long-running space battles and thousands of Space Marines fighting alien monstrosities and even each other.
paragraphs.cn: Eisenhorn是科幻犯罪小说三部曲，围绕审判官Gregor Eisenhorn与Gideon Ravenor展开（Ravenor后来拥有自己的衍生系列）。故事大意是：他们追捕异端与恶魔，同时抵御混沌足以击溃心智的力量。虽然故事设定在《战锤40,000》宇宙中，但相较于其他涉及持久太空战、数千名星际战士与异形怪物乃至彼此交战的横跨银河的40K故事，它的焦点更集中、规模也更小。

paragraphs.en: The Eisenhorn saga includes a spinoff series that revolves around an Inquisitorial agent called Alizebeth Bequin. The first novel in the Bequin series, Pariah, came out in 2012. Its sequel, the Warhammer 40,000 lore treasure trove that is Penitent, followed nearly a decade later, in March 2021. The hotly anticipated third novel in the series, Pandaemonium, does not have a release date, and the wait for an announcement is fast becoming Warhammer 40,000’s version of George R. R. Martin’s M.I.A. Game of Thrones book, The Winds of Winter.
paragraphs.cn: Eisenhorn传奇还包括一个围绕审判庭特工Alizebeth Bequin展开的衍生系列。Bequin系列第一部小说《Pariah》于2012年出版；近十年后的2021年3月，续作《Penitent》问世，它堪称《战锤40,000》设定的宝库。系列备受期待的第三部《Pandaemonium》尚无发售日期，迟迟等不到消息的状况正迅速变成《战锤40,000》版的乔治·R·R·马丁小说《凛冬的寒风》。

paragraphs.en: Why should so many Warhammer 40,000 lore lovers care so much about Pandaemonium? Because it promises to actually move the overarching plot forward. Penitent ended with a significant lore revelation (it has to do with the identity of the mysterious King in Yellow, which we won’t spoil here), and so the ramifications of Pandaemonium could be huge. Everyone wants to know what happens next, and is badgering Abnett to get on and write the damn book.
paragraphs.cn: 为什么如此多热爱《战锤40,000》设定的读者如此在意《Pandaemonium》？因为它承诺会真正推进整体剧情。《Penitent》以一次重大的设定揭示收尾（涉及神秘「黄衣之王」的身份，本文就不剧透了），所以《Pandaemonium》的影响可能极其重大。所有人都想知道后续发展，正不停催促Abnett赶紧把这该死的书写出来。

paragraphs.en: Then, last year, a seemingly innocuous Facebook post by Abnett himself promoting his attendance at the Broadside Games Show in the English town of Gillingham, Kent, got Warhammer 40,000 fans talking. It included a warning of sorts:
paragraphs.cn: 随后，去年Abnett本人在Facebook上发布了一则看似平常的帖子，宣传他将出席英国肯特郡吉灵厄姆镇的Broadside Games Show；这则帖子让《战锤40,000》粉丝议论起来，其中附带了某种警告：

paragraphs.en: So, Abnett is bound by a non-disclosure agreement that prevents him from explaining why Pandaemonium and “some other things” are “held up for a while.” That on its own wouldn’t warrant such attention, but in combination with a reddit post from last year, it certainly does set the cat among the pigeons.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，Abnett受一份保密协议约束，无法解释为什么《Pandaemonium》和「其他一些事情」会「暂时搁置」。单凭这一点本不值得如此关注，但结合去年一则Reddit帖子来看，确实足以引发轩然大波。

paragraphs.en: In March 2025, at a book signing in a Warhammer store in Maidstone, Kent. Zigoia reported that Abnett told him that the delay for Pandaemonium “is because of the potential lore impact it’s going to have on the setting — and is due to GW wanting to get the lore in the TV show totally settled first. They apparently don’t want to end up having some of the potentially galaxy shaking events of Pandaemonium contradict what they lay out in the show.”
paragraphs.cn: 2025年3月，在肯特郡梅德斯通一家战锤门店的签售会上，Zigoia报道称，Abnett告诉他，《Pandaemonium》延期「是因为它将对设定产生潜在影响；Games Workshop希望先把电视剧中的设定完全敲定。显然，他们不希望《Pandaemonium》中一些可能撼动银河的事件，与他们在剧中铺陈的内容相互矛盾」。

paragraphs.en: With all this in mind, I think Cavill will play Eisenhorn, from Abnett’s saga of the same name. If the delay to Pandaemonium is due to Games Workshop wanting to get its Amazon ducks in a row so the TV show slots neatly into Warhammer 40,000 canon and veteran fans and newcomers alike aren’t faced with two sets of contradicting lore, you can see why the revelations of Pandaemonium might have to wait for Flanagan’s script.
paragraphs.cn: 综合这些情况，我认为卡维尔会饰演Abnett同名系列中的Eisenhorn。如果《Pandaemonium》的延期，确实是因为Games Workshop想先协调好与亚马逊的安排，让电视剧能顺利纳入《战锤40,000》正史，避免老粉丝和新观众面对两套相互矛盾的设定，那么就能理解为什么《Pandaemonium》揭示的内容可能得等弗拉纳根的剧本完成后再公布。

paragraphs.en: An Eisenhorn adaptation would, theoretically at least, be tighter in scope than some of the grander Warhammer 40,000 stories, and help keep production manageable. The Eisenhorn Omnibus series does feature Space Marines, but they only make brief and rare appearances. The story focuses heavily on Gregor Eisenhorn and regular humans rather than the giant genetically enhanced warriors.
paragraphs.cn: 理论上，Eisenhorn改编剧的规模会比一些更宏大的《战锤40,000》故事更紧凑，也有助于让制作保持可控。Eisenhorn Omnibus系列确实有星际战士登场，但他们出现得既短暂又罕见。故事重点放在Gregor Eisenhorn与普通人身上，而不是那些体型庞大、经基因强化的战士。

paragraphs.en: Well, it’s either that, or Cavill will play the King in Yellow himself.
paragraphs.cn: 要么是这样，要么卡维尔会亲自饰演黄衣之王。

paragraphs.en: This thing is still years away, unfortunately, so it may be some time before we get any official word. Cavill, in a recent interview with Esquire , touched on the “complexity” and “trickiness” of adapting the Warhammer 40,000 IP. But, he insisted, he was loving the challenge. Bringing Warhammer to life "is a dream come true," Cavill said, "but it's different from what I've done before, in the sense I haven't had my hand on the tiller of things before. It's wonderful doing that. It is a tricky IP, and a very complex IP, and that's what I love about it. The challenges that come with putting this on the page in a way that is doing justice to that complexity, that trickiness, and that nuance, is a challenge I'm enjoying enormously."
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，这件事距离实现仍有数年，所以我们可能还得过一段时间才能听到官方消息。卡维尔最近接受Esquire采访时谈到了改编《战锤40,000》IP的「复杂性」和「棘手之处」，但他坚持说自己很享受这项挑战。卡维尔说：「让《战锤》走进现实‘可谓梦想成真’，但它与我过去做的事不同，因为此前我从未亲自掌舵。能这样做非常棒。这个IP既棘手又极其复杂，而这正是我喜爱它的原因。如何将它呈现在纸面上，并真正尊重其复杂性、棘手之处和细微差别，所带来的挑战让我非常享受。」

paragraphs.en: When the Games Workshop / Amazon deal was announced, Cavill issued a statement on Instagram saying he’d been “working away in concept rooms, breaking down approaches to the enormity and magnificence of the Warhammer world."
paragraphs.cn: Games Workshop与亚马逊的协议公布时，卡维尔曾在Instagram发表声明，称自己一直「在概念创作室里工作，拆解如何呈现《战锤》世界的宏大与壮丽」。

paragraphs.en: He added: "Together, we've been sifting through the plethora of incredible characters and poring over old tomes and texts. Our combined efforts have led us to a fantastic place to start our Universe, which has been agreed upon by those up on high at both Amazon and Games Workshop. That starting place shall, for now, remain a secret. Watch this space, though — more to come in time!"
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「我们一起筛选了大量不可思议的角色，也仔细研读了古老的典籍与文本。我们的共同努力让我们找到了一个绝佳的宇宙起点，亚马逊和Games Workshop的高层都已同意这个起点。不过目前，它仍将是个秘密。敬请关注，未来还会有更多消息！」

opus_summary: 《战锤40,000》剧集由弗拉纳根主创，卡维尔仍将主演。作者推测卡维尔可能饰演Eisenhorn；《Pandaemonium》延期或与剧集设定协调有关。
